scenes.text: This tutorial covers Mask. Segment the supplied four-channel microscopy experiment into nuclei, cells, lipid droplets, and parasite masks.
Open Mask from the Core section. Use the supplied thirteen-field dataset. Channel zero is nuclei, channel one is endoplasmic reticulum, channel two is lipid droplets, and channel three is parasites.
In the main configuration area, detect nuclei from channel zero, cells from the endoplasmic-reticulum channel, lipid droplets with the organelle spots workflow, and parasites from channel three.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. Check a representative field, then run the four segmentation passes across the dataset.
When the workflow finishes, the masks folder contains aligned object labels and merged image-plus-mask arrays ready for measurement.
